summary: Iteration 50 — Phase 2 (operational impersonate) + Phase 3 (financial module) end-to-end. Backend pytest 18/19 PASS, 1 SKIP (Phase 1 regression couldn't find partner with associated company; not in scope). Frontend smoke + integration: Resumo hero verde + 3 cost cards + Margem por Cliente table render correctly (all 4 KPIs Receita/Custos/Lucro/Margem present, month input + Atualizar btn work). Despesas tab opens '+ Nova despesa' modal with all 5 fields (Descrição/Valor/Data/Categoria/Notas) — modal validates 'Preencha descrição, valor e data' when description empty (good). Comissões tab renders period + status (Todas/Paid/Pending) filters + empty state. Meu Painel hero violeta + 'Abrir meu painel operacional' button → confirmed POST /api/super-admin/me/operational-impersonate returns HTTP 200 with valid JWT (token_len=371) + company_slug='crmtest' + company_name='CRM Test' (verified via curl). Configurações tab has 'Empresa Operacional do SuperAdmin' select (CRM Test pre-selected) and helper text correctly mentions 'Meu Painel'. All 4 financial endpoints respond correctly with no MongoDB _id leakage.

issues: Description input has no placeholder text or data-testid, making automated form-fill harder. Suggest adding data-testid='expense-desc-input' / 'expense-amount-input' / 'expense-date-input' / 'expense-category-select' / 'expense-save-btn' / 'expense-delete-btn-{id}' / 'expense-edit-btn-{id}' for E2E reliability.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid attributes to Nova Despesa modal inputs + delete/edit buttons in Despesas list to enable robust E2E automation. Current functionality works via real-user interaction; only impacts automated testability.

(Optional) Phase 1 regression for partner commission credit could not run because /api/super-admin/partners/{id}/referenced-clients returned no data — main agent may want to seed a partner→company association for future regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: super_admin_finance_routes.py (344 lines, single file) — clean, well-documented module with proper async/await, Pydantic ExpenseIn validation, Mongo _id excluded via {'_id':0} projections everywhere, HTTPException(400/404/409) used appropriately. _month_bounds handles invalid YYYY-MM gracefully (400). Yearly plans correctly amortized to monthly cost via cost/12. Financial summary build is O(n) per collection, no N+1 issues.

Operational impersonate endpoint properly preserves audit trail via 'impersonated_by' claim in JWT + 120min expiry. Falls back to any company_user when no company_admin present (matches existing impersonate flow). Distinguishes 400 (no setting) vs 404 (target missing) vs 409 (no users) — excellent UX for SuperAdmin error handling.

Phase 3 expense CRUD: PUT/DELETE return 404 with consistent message 'Despesa nao encontrada' — verified. POST returns the persisted doc (re-fetched from DB) so the client sees server-generated id + created_at, no need for second GET. Good DX.

MINOR: Frontend modal 'Nova Despesa' relies on validation toast 'Preencha descricao, valor e data' to prevent empty-description inserts, but POST /api/super-admin/expenses backend would gladly accept description='' (Pydantic str allows empty). Defense-in-depth: add `min_length=1` to ExpenseIn.description so the API rejects junk too.

Smart that financial/summary aggregates revenue from invoices.paid_at (falling back to due_date) — reflects realistic accounting where paid_at may be back-dated. invoices_count vs active_companies are useful UI counters, exposed at root for easy access.

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18 in scope; 1 skip not blocking — no partner/company association in seed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 5 sub-tabs (Resumo/Faturas/Despesas/Comissões/Clientes Externos) render; Meu Painel + Configurações render with correct hero + helper text; impersonate API call confirmed via real button click (HTTP 200).
